title: Choices (if / else)
instructions: if (something is true) { ... } runs the lines inside only when the question is true.
else { ... } runs when it was false.
Questions use > (bigger), < (smaller), >= , <= , == (the same) and != (not the same).
Remember: == asks a question, but a single = changes a box.
task: Finish the if so the program prints:  15 is big
